newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nomura starts J.P. Morgan.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nomura starts J.P. Morgan.

text.p: -- Nomura Research said it started coverage of J.P. Morgan & Co Inc with a buy rating
-- Nomura estimates J.P. Morgan will earn $7.56/shr in 1996, $7.93/shr in 1997 and $8.52/shr in 1998

-- Nomura says year-to-date rise of 22 percent in stock has lagged Nomura bank universe. Analyst says shares are undervalued and present a good buying opportunity in light of management's increased focus on return on equity. Nomura also notes attractiveness of company if an economic slowdown leads to a "flight to quality"
